result.title: Plan Big, Paint Small: Semantic-Aware Computation Allocation for Efficient Autoregressive Video Generation
result.summary: Autoregressive (AR) video diffusion streams a video chunk by chunk, but large AR models are too slow for real-time use. We ask where in an AR rollout a large model is actually needed. Pairing Krea-Realtime-14B with Self-Forcing-1.3B, which share their latent space and denoising schedule, we find that the order of the two models matters: when the 14B model generates only the first chunk and the 1.3B model continues, the rollout keeps 95\% of the 14B model's semantic advantage, whereas the reverse allocation keeps 16\% at about ten times the cost. The large model decides what the video shows; the small model only has to carry it forward. We turn this into BigSmall, a training-free planner--renderer sampler. The 14B model plans the opening chunk and sketches the chunks in which content changes, which preserves motion, and the 1.3B model renders the rest; a faster variant, BigSmall, plans only the opening chunk. A cross-model KV cache that is approximate, windowed and lazy lets the planner leave and re-enter the rollout at low cost. On VBench, BigSmall is $3.02\times$ faster than the 14B model at an unchanged semantic score and motion, and $1.55\times$ faster than SDVG, which lets the small model draft first; BigSmall reaches $3.77\times$ at the same semantic score, trading away 10\% of the motion. On minute-long videos (LoCoT2V-Bench), where the 14B model degrades when it reads its own long history, BigSmall is $3.14\times$ faster than the 14B model and scores higher ($+1.78$).`

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究自回归视频生成中大型模型在 rollout 的哪个位置才真正必要，发现让 14B 模型只生成首个 chunk、由 1.3B 模型续写可保留 95% 的语义优势，据此提出免训练的规划—渲染采样器 BigSmall，并用近似、窗口化、惰性的跨模型 KV cache 降低大模型进出 rollout 的开销。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「只在语义关键片段调用大模型、其余交给小模型延续」的计算分配，以及跨模型近似窗口 KV cache 的状态交接，可能为 LVR 中动态计算分配与 latent 状态在模型间传递复用提供可供核查的线索，但领域为视频生成，需进一步判断可迁移性。
